## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed 850 reads during 382 hours of grading activity. This represents a rate of 2.2 reads per hour. The workload information was reviewed by Priya Anand and provides the basis for the quality review described below.

## Quality

A sample of 55 reads was checked as part of the review. Agreement across the checked work was 40.0 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent grading and to identify areas requiring further attention. Priya Anand reviewed the checked work and provided feedback to Tomas Brennan.
